kinds.isme: taken from the ISME report (Gutachten ISME, Dec 2023)
kinds.tested: chosen by testing variants against real per-district data
kinds.calibrated: solved so the city-wide result matches an ISME figure
kinds.assumption: rule of thumb or team decision, no direct source

parameters.label: E-Auto-Basis
parameters.note: today: registered EVs per Unterbezirk (no forecast). scenario: private cars × bevShareScenario.

parameters.label: E-Anteil heute (Stadt)
parameters.source: Stadt Dortmund, Auswertung der Statistik 2026: 12,715 E-PKW / 301,395 PKW
parameters.note: Used for commuters and tourists, who have no per-district EV count.

parameters.label: E-Anteil Szenario
parameters.note: Optimistic: today 4.2 %, +1,500–2,600 EVs per year; 18 % by 2030 needs ~11,000 per year.

parameters.label: E-Autos je Ladepunkt im Straßenraum
parameters.source: Gutachten ISME, tab. 4 and 5 (from NPM 2020 / MiD)

parameters.label: Heimladen, Stadtmittel (Kalibrierziel)
parameters.source: Gutachten ISME, tab. 5: 40,179 of 60,616 resident BEV charge at a detached house or apartment block

parameters.label: Zusätzliche Lademöglichkeit (Einfahrt) je Wohnung in Ein-/Zweifamilienhäusern
parameters.source: Best of 0 / 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 when predicting the real private EV share per Unterbezirk (docs/factor-model.md, validation)

parameters.label: Private Lademöglichkeiten je Wohnung in Mehrfamilienhäusern
parameters.source: Solved so the car-weighted city mean of home coverage equals homeShareCity; 0.409 at the defaults
parameters.note: Recalculated whenever drivewayPerDwelling or useOsmFactor change and calibrate is true.

parameters.label: Auf ISME-Heimladen kalibrieren
parameters.labelEn: Calibrate to the ISME home share

parameters.label: OSM-Faktor je Stadtbezirk für Mehrfamilienhäuser
parameters.source: Raises the cross-validated R² from 0.54 to 0.60 (docs/factor-model.md, validation)
parameters.note: Low values in Eving (0.31) and Mengede (0.46) may reflect thin OSM mapping.

parameters.label: Anteil der Anwohner ohne Heimladen, die im Straßenraum laden
parameters.labelEn: Residents without home charging who use street space
parameters.source: Gutachten ISME, p. 16 and tab. 5: 2,979 street points × 2.8 = 8,341 of 20,437 resident BEV without home charging

parameters.label: Einpendelnde (brutto)
parameters.note: The ISME report uses the net balance (38,151), about 4× too low for charging in Dortmund.

parameters.label: Anteil Pendler-BEV, die im Straßenraum laden
parameters.labelEn: Commuter EVs charging in street space
parameters.source: Gutachten ISME, p. 16: 107 street points × 2.8 = 300 of 4,491 commuter BEV; the rest charge at the employer

parameters.label: Geschossfläche je Arbeitsplatz
parameters.source: Planning rules of thumb; mixed-use residential buildings count half their floor area
parameters.note: Not fitted. Check: 269,963 estimated jobs vs. 264,322 employees at place of work (Open Data, 2024).

parameters.label: Personen je Pkw
parameters.note: The ISME report counts every guest as one car. Leisure trips are likely above the average, so 1.46 is conservative.

parameters.label: Anteil Gäste-BEV mit Ladebedarf am Ziel
parameters.labelEn: Visitor EVs that charge at the destination
parameters.note: Most day guests come from the region and get home without charging. 1.0 reproduces the ISME assumption.

parameters.label: Anteil der ladenden Gäste im Straßenraum
parameters.source: Gutachten ISME, p. 16: 2,481 street points × 2.8 = 6,947 of 12,168 tourist BEV
parameters.note: Where charging guests charge (street vs car park, customer parking, HPC).

parameters.label: Besucher je Jahr für Ziele ohne Zahl
parameters.note: Between the smaller museums (6,000–41,000) and the Naturmuseum (128,000).

parameters.label: Veranstaltungsorte und Stadien als Dauerbedarf zählen
parameters.note: Match days and fairs are peaks, not everyday demand. Overnight guests of events are still counted via hotels.

parameters.label: Ladepunkte je Bestandsstandort
parameters.source: The ISME report counts 498 public points in 2023; 912 locations in 2026 fit 1 point each better than 2 (1,824).
